# Fixture Vehicle Registration Rules

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Registration

A vehicle must be registered within 14 days of purchase. The registration fee is 75 euros.

## 2 Documents

Owners present proof of ownership, a valid insurance certificate and Form VR-12.

## 3 Inspection

Vehicles older than four years must pass a safety inspection every 12 months.
